# Tolkira

> Tolkira converts Cucumber legacy JSON, Cucumber Messages (NDJSON), JUnit XML
> and Playwright JSON into one self-contained, interactive HTML report or a
> script-free `--static` report, plus an optional HTML email summary and an
> optional Chromium PDF, and prints a stable JSON summary for CI and AI agents.
> `--capabilities` prints the installed surface and `--manifest` records the
> run's files and first failures. Opt-in aggregate history (`--history`,
> `--history-limit`) adds Trends, and a two-run `--baseline` comparison diffs an
> earlier schema-2 summary. It requires Node.js 22 or newer and runs offline with
> no server, CDN or telemetry.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tolkira

License: MIT

## Start here

- [Documentation map](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/README.md):
  entry point to product, architecture, compatibility and research docs.
- [README](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/README.md): install,
  quick start, migration from cucumber-html-reporter and MCHR, decision matrix.
- [Agent interface](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/AGENT-INTERFACE.md):
  CLI, API, JSON summary schema 2, capabilities, manifest and exit codes.
- [Agent snippet](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/AGENT-SNIPPET.md):
  copy-paste block for an `AGENTS.md`, a skill or a tool description.
- [CI output](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/CI.md):
  GitHub and Azure annotations, Jenkins HTML Publisher, sharded reports,
  GitLab and step summaries, caps and exit codes.
- [Email summary](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/EMAIL.md):
  opt-in HTML mail body with `--email`, 600 px inline template, report note and
  CI mail-step example; no sending, no SMTP and no network.
- [PDF export](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/PDF.md):
  opt-in `--pdf`, `--pdf-timeout` and `renderPdf`, optional Playwright Chromium
  install in the project, A4 portrait print archive, write order and limits.
- [Drop-in host validation](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/DROP-IN-VALIDATION.md):
  real host projects run before releases and major adapter/report changes.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/LIMITATIONS.md):
  dated status of Behave coverage, JUnit, Playwright, themes and attachments.
- [Playwright JSON](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/PLAYWRIGHT-JSON.md):
  native Playwright mapping, statuses, attachments and limits.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md):
  cucumber-html-reporter shim mapping and caveats.
- [Localisation](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/I18N.md):
  `--locale`, catalog schema, fallback, German glossary and agent checklist.
- [Cucumber compatibility](https://github.com/Silasoa/tolkira/blob/main/docs/CUCUMBER-COMPATIBILITY.md):
  tested producers and versions.

## Rules for agents

- Generate the summary with `tolkira <inputs> --json` and parse stdout; do not
  scrape the HTML for pass/fail data.
- Exit code 0 means the requested output was generated (report, summary or
  manifest), not that the tests passed. Read `status` and `counts` from the
  summary or the manifest.
- Check `scenarios[].executed` before treating a scenario status as an outcome.
- Use `tolkira --capabilities` for the installed inputs, outputs, limits and exit
  codes, and `--manifest run.json` for the run's status, counts, written files
  and first 10 failures; the manifest can be the only output.
- Use `tolkira <inputs> --ci github` for GitHub annotations on stdout,
  `--ci azure` for Azure DevOps logging commands, or `--ci markdown` for a step
  summary or GitLab file. Messages are not redacted.
- Attach `report.html` as the human-facing artifact; keep the JSON summary for
  automation.
- Use `--static` when the report must open without JavaScript (no search,
  filters, copy or lightbox; all details open); use
  `--history`/`--history-limit` for aggregate Trends and `--baseline` for a
  two-run diff against an earlier schema-2 `--json` summary. History is
  aggregate-only; the baseline is a read-only comparison, not a run store or
  dashboard.
- Use `tolkira <inputs> --out report.html --email email.html` for a small HTML
  mail body. With `--out` it names the report basename; standalone it says no
  full report is attached. It stays local and never sends mail; attach
  `report.html` separately. Tolkira exits 0 on failing tests, so take a mail
  subject from `summary.json` (`status`), not from the job status.
- Add `--pdf report.pdf` for the complete A4 portrait print archive only when the
  optional Playwright Chromium engine is installed in the project where Tolkira
  runs (`npm i -D playwright-core@^1.65.0`, then
  `npx playwright-core install chromium-headless-shell`). The PDF is
  Chromium-only, has no CLI filter, Letter/custom paper or page numbers, and is
  written before the email;
  a missing engine exits 1. `--pdf-timeout <ms>` overrides the five-minute
  render deadline.
